findings.title: Missing content-security-policy
findings.recommendation: CSP helps restrict the sources from which browser content may load.

findings.title: Missing x-content-type-options
findings.recommendation: Set nosniff to reduce MIME-type sniffing risks.

findings.title: Missing referrer-policy
findings.recommendation: Set an intentional referrer policy to limit referrer data leakage.

findings.title: Missing permissions-policy
findings.recommendation: Restrict browser features the site does not need.

findings.title: Website origin uses HTTP
findings.evidence: The configured origin is not HTTPS
findings.recommendation: Use HTTPS for public sites and redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

notes: One GET request was made to the exact allowlisted origin.
No crawling, path probing, form submission, credential testing, or exploitation was performed.
